scope: Qualify a selected AC1027 source-bound MLINE retarget from a three-element source style to a separately named two-element target style formed by removing the middle offset. Both open, unfilled, uncut consumers (one in ENTITIES and one in a BLOCK) are reprojected. This is not general MLINE retarget or native-rendering qualification.

references.use: Defines MLINESTYLE group 70 geometry flags, group 71 element count, and ordered per-element groups 49, 62, and 6. It identifies entity group 340 and the MLINESTYLE dictionary key as the authoritative retarget references; group 2 names are redundant.

Defines group 73 element count; groups 74/41/75/42 parameter arrays; per-vertex geometry groups; and states that group-41 lists do not depend on linetypes. This supports the selected offset-based reprojection field model, not native rendering acceptance.

implementation.change: Add an AC1027-only retarget-removal admission path for open, unfilled, uncut MLINEs with flags 2 and unchanged start/end angles. It accepts a nonempty ordered target offset subset, reprojects group-41 parameters and group-73 arity, and preserves redundant group-2 names while the authoritative group-340 reference changes. Target colors and linetypes remain those of the selected target style. Add exact physical-field/reference checks, fresh readback, a non-subset refusal, late-mutation failure, destination preservation, and same-adapter retry controls.
implementation.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface changes. The new retarget-removal path is explicitly gated to AC1027; other source versions retain existing refusal behavior. Runtime-generated inputs/outputs are removed after successful test runs.

fixturePolicy: The test authors its AC1027 DXF input and outputs at runtime in a system temporary directory and removes successful-run artifacts. No drawing fixture was committed.
limits: Only the source-count-three to target-count-two profile removing the middle offset is newly qualified; this receipt does not qualify every ordered subset or count even though the bounded projector admits them.
The exact profile uses flags 2, equal 90/90 angles, one ENTITIES consumer, and one BLOCKS consumer. Other flags, angle changes, carriers, source versions and native rendering remain open.
This field/readback evidence does not establish native MLINE rendering, complete-document conversion, or a format-support claim.
